findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gvt_run_visibility_test, gvt_get_test_results, gvt_list_tests, gvt_get_baseline, gvt_get_latest, gvt_list_baselines, gvt_get_score_trend, gvt_list_sitemap_urls, gvt_set_test_visibility, gvt_run_visibility_batch, gvt_get_batch_status, gvt_get_batch_summary, gvt_list_schedules, gvt_get_fix, gvt_list_prompts · Private data: gvt_set_test_visibility, gvt_get_batch_status, gvt_get_fix · Public sink: gvt_set_test_visibility, gvt_run_visibility_batch · Destructive: gvt_run_visibility_test, gvt_get_baseline, gvt_get_latest, gvt_list_sitemap_urls, gvt_delete_test, gvt_run_visibility_batch, gvt_schedule_test, gvt_list_prompts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gvt_run_visibility_test, gvt_get_test_results, gvt_list_tests, gvt_get_baseline, gvt_get_latest, gvt_list_baselines, gvt_get_score_trend, gvt_list_sitemap_urls, gvt_set_test_visibility, gvt_run_visibility_batch, gvt_get_batch_status, gvt_get_batch_summary, gvt_list_schedules, gvt_get_fix, gvt_list_prompts · Private data: gvt_set_test_visibility, gvt_get_batch_status, gvt_get_fix · Public sink: gvt_set_test_visibility, gvt_run_visibility_batch · Destructive: gvt_run_visibility_test, gvt_get_baseline, gvt_get_latest, gvt_list_sitemap_urls, gvt_delete_test, gvt_run_visibility_batch, gvt_schedule_test, gvt_list_prompts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
